text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a canary deploy for engine + kernel bump + new quant profile. Target window Thu 15:00 UTC. Looking for an owner + smoke runner.

tim: I can own the canary and run smoke.

ajay: FYI the quant profile change is q4_0 for LLaMA-2-13B only (no pruning). Kernel includes a 1.14 perf/security patch.

lucy: images built on CI are under ci/engine:pr-894, please make sure perf dashboard tags include kernel=1.14.

maria: checklist for owner: - confirm smoke script - confirm rollback image - set alerts/dashboards - announce start in thread - be oncall for +30m after start

samir: sharing quick smoke script snippet:
```bash
./smoke.sh --model llama-2-13b --profile q4_0 --seq 2048 --requests 50
```

tim: I'll run that. Abort criteria: 95th latency > 400ms or >0.5% error. OK?

ajay: OK. I'll prepare rollback image: redwood/engine:sha-abc122 (previous). Keeping it ready in the registry.

lucy: please add the metric tag 'kernel=1.14' so alerts and dashboards route to the new canary group.

maria: good. Devops CI passed earlier — see deploy info.

devops-bot: CI build passed for pr-894, docker image: redwood/engine:sha-abc123

tim: starting canary in 2m. I'll post the deploy-bot command here when it goes.

deploy-bot: scheduling canary: redwood-canary-us-east (10 nodes) at 2026-03-19T15:00:00Z

oncall-bot: oncall notice — jem is assigned pager for next 30m

tim: smoke run finished: p50=120ms p95=370ms errors=0/50 :thumbsup:

ajay: monitoring traces now — watching for tokenization diffs and generation anomalies.

lucy: what size to expand to next?

maria: hold at 10 nodes for 15m for observation, then grad to 30% if stable. If any rule triggers rollback to redwood/engine:sha-abc122.

tim: noted. I'll ping here at +10 and +15.

maria: thanks everyone — please file any follow-ups as a quick PR against the rollout playbook if we need changes to thresholds or scripts.

(End of thread)
